name: Decision result
description: What a body decided. Agenda items and votes share this predicate, so both sets of outcomes are declared here; an absent result means not yet decided, which is distinct from a decision to take no action.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Amended
hasDefinedTerm.description: Agreed in modified form. Agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Deferred
hasDefinedTerm.description: Postponed to a later sitting. Agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Referred
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sent to another body for consideration. Agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Withdrawn
hasDefinedTerm.description: Removed before a decision was taken. Agenda item or vote.

hasDefinedTerm.name: No action
hasDefinedTerm.description: Considered, with a deliberate decision to do nothing. Agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Received
hasDefinedTerm.description: Noted without a decision, e.g. a report. Agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Failed
hasDefinedTerm.description: The motion did not carry. Vote.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Tied
hasDefinedTerm.description: Equal votes; the outcome turns on the body's tie-breaking rule. Vote.
